summary.en: This / these are near you, that / those are farther away. These and those are plural.
summary.es: This / these = este(s), cerca. That / those = ese(s) o aquel(los), lejos.
summary.pt: This / these = este(s), perto. That / those = esse(s) ou aquele(s), longe.
summary.zh: this/these 指近处（这），that/those 指远处（那）；these/those 是复数。

en: Singular: this book, that car. Plural: these books, those cars.
They can stand alone: What is this? I like that.
That is also used for things just mentioned: That's great!
es: No cambian con el género: this book, this table (este libro, esta mesa).
Plural: these books, those cars.
También solos: What is this? (¿Qué es esto?)
pt: Não mudam com o gênero: this book, this table (este livro, esta mesa).
Plural: these books, those cars.
Também sozinhos: What is this? (O que é isto?)
zh: 单数：this book（这本书），that car（那辆车）。
复数要变：these books（这些书），those cars（那些车）。
也可以单独用：What is this?（这是什么？）

title.en: In, on, at: place and time
title.es: In, on, at: lugar y tiempo
title.pt: In, on, at: lugar e tempo

summary.en: At for a point (at 5 pm, at home), on for days and surfaces (on Monday, on the table), in for longer periods and inside (in May, in the box).
summary.es: At para un punto (at 5 pm), on para días y superficies (on Monday), in para periodos largos y dentro (in May).
summary.pt: At para um ponto (at 5 pm), on para dias e superfícies (on Monday), in para períodos longos e dentro (in May).
summary.zh: at 表示点（at 5 pm），on 表示日期和表面（on Monday），in 表示较长时间和里面（in May）。

en: Time: at 7:00, at night; on Friday, on June 3; in July, in 2027, in the morning.
Place: at the station (a point), on the wall (a surface), in the kitchen (inside).
These are learned best as fixed phrases: at home, at work, on the bus, in the car.
es: En español "en" sirve para todo. En inglés depende: at 7:00, on Friday, in July.
Lugar: at the station (un punto), on the wall (una superficie), in the kitchen (dentro).
Apréndelas como frases hechas: at home, at work, on the bus, in the car.
pt: Em português "em" serve para tudo. Em inglês depende: at 7:00, on Friday, in July.
Lugar: at the station (um ponto), on the wall (uma superfície), in the kitchen (dentro).
Aprenda como expressões fixas: at home, at work, on the bus, in the car.
zh: 中文常用“在”，英语要区分：at 7:00, on Friday, in July。
地点：at the station（一个点），on the wall（表面上），in the kitchen（里面）。
最好整句记住：at home, at work, on the bus, in the car。

concepts.pattern: at / on / in + time or place

summary.en: Use a before consonant sounds, an before vowel sounds, and the for something specific.
summary.es: A va antes de un sonido consonante, an antes de un sonido vocal, y the para algo concreto.
summary.pt: A vem antes de som de consoante, an antes de som de vogal, e the para algo específico.
summary.zh: 辅音开头用 a，元音开头用 an，特指某个东西用 the。

en: A and an mean "one": a book, an apple. The choice depends on the sound, not the letter: an hour, a university.
The is for a thing you both already know about: Close the door.
English has no gender for articles. The is the same for singular and plural.
es: A y an equivalen a "un / una": a book, an apple. Depende del sonido, no de la letra: an hour, a university.
The equivale a el, la, los y las. En inglés los artículos no tienen género.
Para hablar en general no se usa the: I like music (no "the music").
pt: A e an equivalem a "um / uma": a book, an apple. Depende do som, não da letra: an hour, a university.
The equivale a o, a, os e as. Em inglês os artigos não têm gênero.
Para falar em geral não se usa the: I like music (e não "the music").
zh: 中文没有冠词，所以这是常见难点。a / an 表示“一个”：a book, an apple。看发音，不看字母：an hour, a university。
the 表示说话双方都知道的那个：Close the door.（关上那扇门）
泛指一类东西时不用 the：I like music.

examples.t: The book is on the table.

tr.es: El libro está en la mesa.

summary.en: Can + verb for ability and permission: I can swim. Can I sit here? It never takes -s.
summary.es: Can + verbo = poder o saber hacer algo: I can swim. Nunca lleva -s.
summary.pt: Can + verbo = poder ou saber fazer algo: I can swim. Nunca leva -s.
summary.zh: can + 动词原形，表示能力或许可：I can swim. 不加 -s。

en: Same form for everyone: I can, she can, they can.
No "to" after can: I can go (not "can to go").
Negative: can't / cannot. Question: Can you help me?
es: Misma forma para todos: I can, she can.
Sin "to" después: I can go (no "can to go").
Negación: can't. Pregunta: Can you help me? (¿Puedes ayudarme?)
pt: Mesma forma para todos: I can, she can.
Sem "to" depois: I can go (não "can to go").
Negação: can't. Pergunta: Can you help me? (Você pode me ajudar?)
zh: 所有人称都用 can：I can, she can。
can 后面直接跟动词原形：I can go（不说 can to go）。
否定 can't，疑问 Can you help me?

summary.en: I / you / we / they have, he / she / it has.
summary.es: Have significa tener. Con he, she, it se dice has.
summary.pt: Have significa ter. Com he, she, it diz-se has.
summary.zh: have 表示“有”；he/she/it 用 has。

en: Possession: I have two brothers. She has a dog.
English uses be, not have, for age and many feelings: I am 20. I am hungry.
Have to + verb means "must": I have to go.
es: Posesión: I have two brothers. She has a dog.
Ojo: la edad y el hambre usan to be: I am 20 (tengo 20 años), I am hungry (tengo hambre).
Have to + verbo = tener que: I have to go.
pt: Posse: I have two brothers. She has a dog.
Atenção: idade usa to be: I am 20 (tenho 20 anos). Fome também: I am hungry.
Have to + verbo = ter que: I have to go.
zh: 表示拥有：I have two brothers. She has a dog.
“There is / there are”表示某处有某物，不用 have：There is a book on the table.
have to + 动词 = 必须：I have to go.

title.es: El verbo to be: am, is, are
title.pt: O verbo to be: am, is, are

summary.en: I am, you are, he / she / it is, we are, they are.
summary.es: To be es a la vez ser y estar: I am tired (estoy), I am a teacher (soy).
summary.pt: To be é ao mesmo tempo ser e estar: I am tired (estou), I am a teacher (sou).
summary.zh: I am, you are, he/she/it is, we/they are。形容词前也要用 be：I am tired。

en: English always needs a subject: It is cold, not "Is cold".
Short forms are normal in speech: I'm, you're, he's, it's.
Negative: add not (I am not, she isn't). Question: move be to the front (Are you ready?).
es: En inglés siempre hace falta el sujeto: It is cold ("hace frío"), nunca solo "Is cold".
To be cubre ser y estar: She is a doctor (es) y She is at home (está).
Pregunta: se invierte el orden: Are you ready? Negación: not después del verbo: I am not.
pt: Em inglês o sujeito é obrigatório: It is cold ("está frio"), nunca só "Is cold".
To be cobre ser e estar: She is a doctor (é) e She is at home (está).
Pergunta: inverte-se a ordem: Are you ready? Negação: not depois do verbo: I am not.
zh: 中文形容词前不用“是”，但英语必须用 be：I am tired（我很累）。
主语和 be 要搭配：I am, he/she/it is, you/we/they are。
疑问句把 be 放到句首：Are you ready? 否定在 be 后加 not：I am not.

title.en: Was and were: the past of be
title.es: Was y were: el pasado de to be
title.pt: Was e were: o passado de to be
title.zh: was 和 were：be 的过去式

summary.en: I / he / she / it was, you / we / they were.
summary.es: Was / were = era, estaba, fue. I was tired (estaba cansado).
summary.pt: Was / were = era, estava, foi. I was tired (estava cansado).
summary.zh: I/he/she/it 用 was，you/we/they 用 were。

en: Use was / were for past states: I was at home yesterday.
Negative: wasn't, weren't. Question: Were you there?
Other verbs use -ed or an irregular form in the past: worked, went.
es: Was / were cubre era, estaba y fue: It was cold (hacía frío), I was at home (estaba en casa).
Negación: wasn't, weren't. Pregunta: Were you there?
Los demás verbos usan -ed o forma irregular: worked, went.
pt: Was / were cobre era, estava e foi: It was cold (estava frio), I was at home (estava em casa).
Negação: wasn't, weren't. Pergunta: Were you there?
Os outros verbos usam -ed ou forma irregular: worked, went.
zh: 中文用“昨天”等时间词表示过去，英语动词本身要变：I was at home yesterday.
否定 wasn't, weren't；疑问 Were you there?
其他动词过去式加 -ed 或不规则变化：worked, went。

title.en: Do and does: questions and negatives
title.es: Do y does: preguntas y negaciones
title.pt: Do e does: perguntas e negativas
title.zh: do 和 does：疑问和否定

summary.en: Most verbs need do / does for questions and negatives: Do you like it? He doesn't work here.
summary.es: Para preguntar o negar con la mayoría de verbos se usa do / does: Do you like it? He doesn't work here.
summary.pt: Para perguntar ou negar com a maioria dos verbos usa-se do / does: Do you like it? He doesn't work here.
summary.zh: 大多数动词的疑问和否定要加 do / does：Do you like it? He doesn't work here.

en: Use does with he, she and it, and do with the others.
After do / does the main verb has no -s: Does she speak English? (not "speaks").
Be and can do not use do: Are you ...? Can you ...?
es: Does con he, she, it; do con los demás.
Después de do / does el verbo va sin -s: Does she speak English? (no "speaks").
To be y can no usan do: Are you ...? Can you ...?
pt: Does com he, she, it; do com os demais.
Depois de do / does o verbo fica sem -s: Does she speak English? (não "speaks").
To be e can não usam do: Are you ...? Can you ...?
zh: he/she/it 用 does，其他用 do。
do/does 后面的动词用原形：Does she speak English?（不是 speaks）
be 动词和 can 不需要 do：Are you ...? Can you ...?
